narrative.intro: QTC Medical Services received $247M in federal contract obligations in FY2027 to date. QTC Medical Services won 9 awards so far, with an average award size of $27.4M. QTC Medical Services obligations are down 89.6% year over year. Fiscal-year obligations rose from $935M in FY22 to $2.9B in FY25 before falling to $2.4B in FY26 and then to $247M in FY27. The Department of Veterans Affairs accounted for $247M of FY2027 to date obligations. The Offices of Physicians (except Mental Health Specialists) market accounted for $247M of FY2027 to date obligations. Current-year totals are partial and represent fiscal year to date activity. These figures are contract obligations except the award-value tables noted on the page, which are total contract values.

sections.heading: How concentrated are QTC Medical Services federal receipts this year?
sections.body: The Department of Veterans Affairs provided $247M of FY2027 to date obligations to QTC Medical Services. The Offices of Physicians (except Mental Health Specialists) market supplied $247M of FY2027 to date obligations. Few other agencies or markets show material obligations in FY2027 to date.

sections.heading: How did QTC Medical Services obligations change versus prior years?
sections.body: QTC Medical Services obligations were $2.9B in FY25 and then $2.4B in FY26 before falling to $247M in FY27. QTC Medical Services obligations are down 89.6% year over year. The recent FY27 total is a fiscal year to date figure and therefore partial.

faq.q: How much does QTC Medical Services make from federal contracts?
faq.a: QTC Medical Services made $247M from federal contracts in FY2027 to date. QTC Medical Services has 9 awards so far this fiscal year and an average award size of $27.4M.

faq.q: Which agencies buy from QTC Medical Services?
faq.a: The Department of Veterans Affairs buys from QTC Medical Services. The Department of Veterans Affairs accounted for $247M of FY2027 to date obligations. Other listed agencies show $0 or negative values in FY2027 to date.

faq.q: What does QTC Medical Services sell to the government?
faq.a: QTC Medical Services sells physician services to the government. The Offices of Physicians (except Mental Health Specialists) market accounted for $247M of FY2027 to date obligations.

faq.q: Which QTC Medical Services contracts are expiring soon?
faq.a: QTC Medical Services has expiring contracts not specified by value in the provided figures. The available FY2027 to date totals are partial and show $247M in obligations for the period.
